subject: Next steps: vendor packet and procurement path for Acme Health
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps: vendor packet and procurement path for Acme Health

Hi Samir — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and a proposed path to get us set up for a PO-based engagement: 

- Outcome from call: Acme wants to proceed with a pilot (production-like access for 90 days) and will onboard Redwood via their purchasing process.
- Procurement preference: you mentioned preference for a standard PO and monthly billing if possible — please confirm.
- Required docs for vendor onboarding: W-9 (for US entities), Redwood vendor packet, and bank remit details. I attached our vendor packet and W-9 to this message as a starting point.

Next steps / asks from your side:
1) Confirm whether Acme will use a PO or prefers card/marketplace routing (this will determine invoicing cadence).
2) If PO: please share the vendor setup contact (procurement@... or portal URL), a preferred remit-to name and ACH details (routing/account or vendor portal upload).
3) If marketplace: confirm which marketplace (if any) and whether we should route billing through that channel.

I've copied Neha and Karthik from Sales Ops to help with the vendor packet and to get our finance team standing by. If it's helpful, I can send a DocuSign SOW for signature while procurement processes the vendor setup.

Attachments (stubs): redwood_vendor_packet_v1.pdf (vendor information + standard T&Cs), W-9_Redwood.pdf, banking_remit_form.xlsx

Thanks — I can be flexible on timelines. Would you be able to share the procurement contact/portal link by end of week?

—Monica
Monica Patel
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acmehealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Next steps: vendor packet and procurement path for Acme Health

Hi Monica — great walkthrough earlier, thanks. A few quick answers: 

- Procurement path: we'll go with a PO and monthly invoices. That aligns best with our internal cadence.
- Vendor docs: we need a completed W-9 (we're US-based) and the vendor packet. I've asked our procurement mailbox to accept electronic uploads. Please upload the vendor packet and remit details to our portal here: https://vendor-portal.acmehealth.com/upload (you'll see "Redwood Inference" as the company name).
- Remit details: please include an ACH remit form or indicate if you prefer us to use the vendor portal to collect banking securely. For reference, our purchasing team prefers portal uploads to avoid emailed banking info.

I'll loop in procurement: procurement@acmehealth.com — they'll confirm required fields and timeline. Expect review within 3–5 business days after you upload.

Thanks — will confirm PO template once procurement responds.

Samir Shah
Senior Product Manager — AI Integrations
Acme Health
samir.shah@acmehealth.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Next steps: vendor packet and procurement path for Acme Health

Neha / Karthik — forwarding Samir's reply (below). Acme is going PO + portal upload. Can Sales Ops start the vendor onboarding checklist and confirm the following items are ready to submit to their portal?

Checklist for Sales Ops / Finance — action items:
- Finalize vendor packet PDF with Redwood's NAICS, EIN, and primary contact (use Monica's contact). (Attachment: redwood_vendor_packet_v1.pdf)
- Confirm W-9 is the correct form (W-9_Redwood.pdf attached). If procurement asks for a W-8 (non-US), we'll handle, but Samir confirmed US.
- Prepare a banking remit form for secure upload (banking_remit_form.xlsx attached). Ideally provide both ACH and wire instructions; do NOT include full account numbers in email body — upload to their portal per Samir.
- Create HubSpot task on deal RDW-2026-ACME-0179 to track vendor upload and PO receipt. Link to Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcmeVendorDocs
- Draft a short invoice template (monthly) so we can issue the first invoice once PO is in place.

Timing: Samir said procurement review ~3–5 business days after upload. Let's aim to have the packet uploaded by EOD 11/04 so we can get the PO in November.

Karthik — confirm you can prepare the invoice template and the HubSpot task. Neha — can you QA the packet (NAICS/EIN) and stamp the file for upload?

If you want me to send a DocuSign SOW in parallel to speed contract signature, say the word and I'll prepare the SOW with the pilot terms.

Thanks,
Monica

1) We will validate the W-9 and remit information (no emailed account numbers please — portal upload is preferred).
2) Expected internal approval window: 3–7 business days depending on compliance checks. We will post a vendor ID and send the PO template once approved.
3) Please ensure invoices reference PO number and "Redwood Inference" as vendor name exactly. If there are any special billing notes (e.g., different remit address for international wires), upload those as separate attachments.
